svg.title: Height model and moving-platform line; shared heights at 1s and 4s
svg.desc: The purple parabola H(t)=-t^2+6t+2 and green line P(t)=t+6 intersect at (1,7) and (4,10). The parabola has a maximum at (3,11). An intersection of heights alone is not evidence of a collision; horizontal position is not modeled.
